map.维护周期怎么定？: How is the maintenance cycle set?
map.参考厂家手册并结合工况：粉尘、潮湿环境应缩短过滤器与排水周期；油雾器按耗油量与用: Refer to the manufacturer manual and combine with the operating condition: dusty or humid environments should shorten filter and drain cycles; oil misters adjust refilling frequency by oil consumption and air use; receiver drain cycles depend on condensate volume.
map.元件台账与维护记录存于浏览器本地存储（localStorage），不上传服务器；: Component ledgers and maintenance records are stored in browser local storage (localStorage) and never uploaded; clearing browser data wipes them, so export or back up periodically.
